text:
Amy (CEO): Heads-up: Thursday 9:30am PT we'll run a 40-minute all-hands — "fireside updates" format. 25m product + infra updates, 15m open Q&A. Please drop quick questions here or use the short form: https://forms.redwood.com/ah-ask.

Ravi - Product: Draft agenda: 1) product priorities & metrics (latency, errors), 2) Dedicated GA timeline, 3) customer highlight (PayLoop), 4) SDK/CLI notes. Slides posted Tue.

Tina - Eng: Adding a 60s note on the last incident postmortem and what changed — routing fallback and cache warmup.

Mark - DevEx: Request: can we reserve 3 minutes for migration guidance for customers on Dedicated? I'll prepare a short snippet.

Amy (CEO): Yes, keep updates concise. If you need more than 3 mins, call it out now. Also we'll record and caption for APAC.

Sofia - People Ops: Quick hiring blurb after the product update with open roles + new comp refresh notes.

Ravi - Product: Slide link: https://drive.redwood.com/ah/updates/draft2 — please comment by Tue EOD.

Tina - Eng: Question for leadership: any planned SLA changes in H2?

Amy (CEO): No SLA changes planned for H2. Focus is on meeting current commitments. We'll announce any changes 30 days ahead.

Mark - DevEx: I'll attach a migration checklist and changelog after the meeting.

all-hands-bot: Reminder set for Thu 9:30am PT. Recording will be posted here.

(After meeting) all-hands-bot: Recording: https://zoom.redwood.com/recordings/3109876543-updates. Transcript in drive.

Ravi - Product: Post-meeting notes: Dedicated GA timeline on track for end of month; latency target progress: p95 down 5%, p99 steady. Customer story: PayLoop reported 20% cost savings with our batching. Slides + follow-ups: https://drive.redwood.com/ah/notes/3109876543.

Tina - Eng: Follow-up: incident mitigations deployed — warmup + fallback rules. Filing rollout ticket for fallback config, cc @Mark - DevEx.

Mark - DevEx: Thanks — will post the SDK migration snippet and readme update tomorrow.

Amy (CEO): Thanks team — key takeaways: maintain SLA stability, finish Dedicated GA, prioritize clear migration comms. If anything urgent, DM me or Ravi.

Sofia - People Ops: Action: People Ops will share hiring one-pager by Friday.

Amy (CEO): Closing — appreciate the quick prep. :clap:
